messages.content: Use 5 emojis or fewer. End your response with this exact line: "Their story explores innocence and experience, freedom and consequence, and the complex relationship between knowledge and responsibility.". Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. Every divider line must be exactly: "=====". Write exactly 6 paragraphs—no more, no less. (Make paragraph breaks clear.)

Write a document about Adam and Eve. Keep it to 4 paragraphs or fewer. (Make paragraph breaks clear.) Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Every divider line must be exactly: "=====". Do not use fewer than 6 emojis. Finish with "Through their creation, choices, and consequences, the account offers insight into morality, responsibility, and the enduring search for meaning in human life." and don’t add anything after it.
